historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta's travels mention a city called Eilshan in present-day Kazakhstan. He visited the city around 1333 CE during the Chagatai Khanate period.

historical_references.reference: Al-Idrisi, a Geographer from Seville, Spain, mentions a city called Eilshan in the 12th century CE in his work 'Nuzhat al-mushtaq fi ikhtiraq al-afaq'. He describes it as a prosperous city in the region of Mawarannahr (Transoxania).
historical_references.context: Al-Idrisi was a geographer and cartographer who wrote a comprehensive description of the world as known to the Muslims at that time. He mentions Eilshan as a prosperous city in the region of Mawarannahr, which was then under the control of the Karakhanid Empire.
